name: 葛瑞斐
objective:
如果英語作為第二語言（ESL）的學生要學習一位西方作家，那麼這位作家應該是莎士比亞。他是極少數既具有文化意義又自去世以來幾乎每個十年都廣受歡迎的作家之一。在二十一世紀，了解一些莎士比亞仍然是受過良好教育的標誌；這
不僅適用於西方人，也適用於世界公民（因為莎士比亞是世界文化的一部分，而不僅僅是英國或西方文化的一部分）。因此，除了為學生提供一些關於莎士比亞及其時代的基本背景知識外，本課程還將深入探討莎士比亞一些最著名戲劇中最著名的段落（例如，《羅密歐與茱麗葉》、《哈姆雷特》、《仲夏夜之夢》）。我們將探討莎士比亞在當今文化中的地位，既作為高雅文化的象徵，也作為流行文化（電影、電視、流行音樂）的常見素材來源。

If ESL students are going to study one Western author, then that author should be Shakespeare. He is one of the few writers who has been both culturally significant and also popular in virtually every decade since his death.  In the twenty-first century, knowing something about Shakespeare is still a sign that a person is well-educated; that is true not just of Westerners, but of citizens of the world (because Shakespeare is a part of world culture, not just British or Western culture).  So, in addition to providing students some basic background on Shakespeare and his times, this class will examine closely some of the most famous passages from some of the most well-known plays of Shakespeare (for example, Romeo and Juliet, Hamlet, A Midsummer Night’s Dream).  We will consider Shakespeare’s place in our culture today, both as a symbol of high culture and as a frequent source of material for popular culture (movies, tv, pop music).
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1	Intro

Week 2	Background on Shakespeare and his time (the Elizabethan period)

Weeks 3-7	Major plays I: famous characters and stories in the tragedies
			King Lear
			Hamlet
			Macbeth			
			Romeo and Juliet 

Week 8	Midterm exam week

Week 9-10	The Sonnets
	
Week 11-13	Major plays II: famous characters and stories in the comedies, romances, and histories
			A Midsummer Night’s Dream
			The Tempest
			Henry V
			
Week 14-15	 Re-writing Shakespeare in Popular Culture

Week 16	Final exam week

Weeks 17-18	Self-Study weeks
				assigned reading
				assigned videos to watch
